question.text: Can an FPI lend or borrow securities in the Indian market?

answer.text: Yes, but only through RBI's securities lending facility
Yes, but only government securities can be lent or borrowed
No, FPIs are prohibited from lending or borrowing securities
Yes, in accordance with the framework specified by SEBI

explanation.text: The Logic: An FPI may lend or borrow securities in accordance with the framework specified by SEBI in this regard. The Trap: FPIs are not prohibited from securities lending and borrowing, nor are they restricted to a single instrument category or an RBI-operated facility — the operative requirement is conformity with the SEBI-specified framework. Note: The SEBI-framework statement is the only point directly grounded in the checked Series III-A workbook pages.
